hero.headline: Condominium management, clearly organized
hero.subtitle: Not a generic property CRM—a workspace shaped around condo finance, assemblies, summons, insurance, and certificates.

features.title: Everything your administration needs
features.subtitle: Replace scattered spreadsheets with one system built for how condominium administration actually works.

properties.title: Properties & units
properties.description: Keep buildings, fractions, and contact details structured and easy to find.

owners.title: Owner records
owners.description: Maintain a reliable owner database with contacts linked to every unit.

payments.title: Condo finance
payments.description: Quotas alone are incomplete—pair collections with expenses, bank balance, and annual budgets from draft to approved.

occurrences.title: Maintenance & incidents
occurrences.description: Log occurrences, follow progress, and keep a clear history per property.

compliance.title: Insurance & certificates
compliance.description: Renewals and validity dates that need attention—first-class records, not bolted-on notes.

reports.title: Reports & clarity
reports.description: See collection health and portfolio trends without digging through files.

howItWorks.title: Up and running in three steps
howItWorks.subtitle: A simple path from setup to day-to-day control.

step1.title: Create your account
step1.description: Sign up and set up your administration workspace in minutes.

step2.title: Add properties & owners
step2.description: Import or enter buildings, units, and the people responsible for each.

step3.title: Run finance & day-to-day
step3.description: Collect quotas, record expenses, watch the bank account, and keep the annual budget moving from draft to approved.

secure.title: Secure by design
secure.description: Your operational data stays in a dedicated workspace with signed-in access.

clarity.title: Clarity over clutter
clarity.description: Dashboards and lists surface what needs attention—without noisy dashboards.

local.title: Condo-native, not a property CRM
local.description: Assemblies, insurance renewals, and certificates live in the domain model—so the product speaks your work, not generic real estate.

cta.title: Bring your condominiums into one place
cta.subtitle: Start with properties, owners, and full condo finance—plus assemblies, insurance, and certificates administrators actually need.
